For example:

I'm always tired, my taste is off, and my throat is really scratchy. I also have muscle pain and heat. My whole body cramps up sometimes.

Please provide your reasoning and final diagnosis.

3. Match the wording, format and level of detail of the examples' answers.

Put the answer itself (keeping any required markup such as [DIAGNOSIS]...[/DIAGNOSIS]) inside "final_answer". Output nothing outside the JSON object.
